title: MARINE STUDIES DEGREE CAPSTONE
description: Examines issues related to the ocean and coasts through a transdisciplinary process recognizing insights from multiple perspectives and disciplines. Integrates the varied content explored in the Marine Studies Major through engagement in a substantial research or creative project evidencing intensive study of the social, political, historical, and/or cultural issues of the ocean and coasts.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisite: MAST 300.
A minimum grade of C- is required in MAST 300.
meeting_html: F 10am-11:50am in BEXL 211 - Bexell Hall 211 (9/23 to 12/4)
